findings.title: onEnable deaths before command hooks leave plugin enabled with zero working commands
findings.problem: Executor/tab-completer binding for /hilltop, /hub and /lobby (lines 206-209) is the last registration step in onEnable, placed after all listener registrations and after the World/structure-touching work of ShopManager.reload(), NpcManager.respawnFromConfig(), WaveManager.cleanupAllOrphans(), MultiArenaManager.loadArenaDefinitions() and the enable queue. Every one of those calls can throw (RespawnFromConfig/NpcManager do world lookups and spawnEntity; cleanupAllOrphans iterates all loaded worlds/entities; loadArenaDefinitions parses arenas.yml and creates worlds). There is no try/catch and no partial-failure rollback: Bukkit does not auto-disable a plugin whose onEnable throws, so the plugin stays enabled with manager fields partly assigned and with getCommand(...).setExecutor never called. Because plugin.yml declares no executor: key, /hilltop and /hub then fall through to the implicit CommandExecutor lucky path only if the main class field is reached, and /lobby//hub tab completion stays unbound; CommandsDocumentGenerator (line 214) is also skipped.
findings.impact: A single bad arenas.yml entry, a missing world folder or one failing world scan converts a config error into 'plugin enabled but every player- and admin-facing command is dead' — /hilltop start/stop/enable/disable/join/gui/reloadconfig all unreachable until a full server restart or /reload, with the failure visible only in console. Players see 'Unknown command' rather than a disabled plugin.
findings.trigger: Server start or /reload with a malformed arenas.yml, an arena world folder that fails to load, or any exception from ShopManager.reload() / NpcManager.respawnFromConfig() / WaveManager.cleanupAllOrphans() executed in onEnable before line 206.

findings.title: Shop respawn failure is swallowed and the whole startup path is left half-initialized
findings.problem: respawnFromConfig() returns void and internally only logs a warning when spawnNpc() fails (NpcManager:301-305), and spawnNpc() returns false both for an invalid world and for the 'another arena is mid-match' cross-world guard. The caller discards this outcome entirely: no retry, no gate, no state marking. Directly after it, cleanupOrphans() (line 159) deletes every PDC-marked shop villager that is not the current npc reference. If the respawn failed because the arena world was not yet loaded at onEnable time, npc is null/stale, so the cleanup pass is free to delete the surviving shop entity from any world that is loaded, and the plugin continues with shopManager non-null and no shop NPC at all.
findings.impact: Lobby/arena shop silently disappears for the whole session (no NPC, no 'shop unavailable' signal), while /hilltop shop give still hands out currency that cannot be spent; the only trace is a single warning line. Because ShopManager is treated as a non-degradable core module (comment at lines 100-104), this is an inconsistency between the stated policy and the actual behaviour.
findings.trigger: Server start or /reload where the arena's world cannot be loaded (missing/corrupt world folder, so ArenaManager.ensureWorldsLoaded() fails, readLocation() logs 'World is not loaded' and the shop-npc Location keeps a null world) — spawnNpc() then returns false, and cleanupOrphans() runs immediately afterwards in the same onEnable pass with npc still null.

findings.title: Pending-clear expiry message always says clearspawns even for mob/villager clears
findings.problem: requestClear() is shared by all three ClearKind values (SPAWN, MOB_SPAWN, VILLAGER) and every other message in that method is dispatched through kind-keyed helpers (warningKey/confirmKey/alreadyKey). The expiry callback is the one exception: it hardcodes "deploy.clearspawns-expired", whose text is 'Clear operation for arena {0} timed out and was cancelled.' The same hardcoded key is repeated in confirmClear() at line 802 for the overdue branch, which is likewise reachable for all three kinds. So a /hilltop deploy clearmobspawns or clearvillagers request that times out reports itself as a spawn-point clear.
findings.impact: Misleading admin feedback only (no state corruption): the admin who requested a mob-spawn or villager clear is told a player-spawn clear expired, which makes it ambiguous whether their destructive operation is still pending before they re-issue it.
findings.trigger: /hilltop deploy clearmobspawns (or clearvillagers) followed by no confirm within 15 s, or by a confirm after the TTL elapsed.

unverified: No build/test execution was performed; all findings are static reads. Reachability of S01-F1's throwing calls depends on runtime state (world folders, arenas.yml contents) that cannot be exercised read-only.

Whether Bukkit/Paper leaves a plugin enabled when onEnable throws before any command hook is registered was not tested at runtime; the finding assumes standard CraftServer behaviour (enable() catches the throwable, logs it, and does not disable the plugin).

may not be quoted: ShopManager.reload() calls ShopConfigLoader.load(), which throws IllegalStateException on a quarantined/truncated shop.yml. That makes onEnable abort before line 206 with an exception rather than with the null-guard degradation the code comments claim, but the throw sites are in S09 and were only read, not audited.
notes: Slice S01 read in full: HilltopVillagePlugin (613 lines), HilltopCommandHandler (1739), ArenaCommand (184), HilltopTabCompleter (209), DeployMenuSender (168). Deliberately dropped as unproven or non-defects after cross-checking callees: (a) countByState/arena-status-statistics — MultiArenaManager returns int[states.length+1] with counts[0] as the total, so the handler's counts[4]+counts[5]+counts[6] mapping is correct despite the misleading javadoc; (b) all i18n keys referenced by this slice exist in messages.yml (257 candidates checked, only permission nodes and the returned-by-API key "deploy.ok" are not message keys); (c) onDisable per-step try/catch isolation and the restoreAllNow() ordering barrier are sound, and every step is null-guarded for early-enable failure; (d) pendingClears uses ConcurrentHashMap plus two-argument remove and record identity, and its delayed task is a plugin task that Bukkit cancels on disable, so no leak or cross-request deletion was found; (e) /hub and /lobby forwarding builds the {"lobby", ...} array correctly, so /lobby setspawn lands in args[1] as handleLobbyCommand expects; (f) ArenaSelectionGUI self-registers in its constructor (gui/ArenaSelectionGUI.java:67), so the main class not registering it is not a missing-listener defect.
